283280518.description: This lot includes two raw apophyllite mineral specimens. The left specimen measures 3x2.5x1 inches and the right specimen measures 2.5x1.5x1.25 inches. Both crystals have a colorless to milky white appearance with transparent to translucent qualities and well-defined hexagonal faces. The larger cluster is roughly oval-shaped while the smaller one is more irregular. Natural matrix is present on the underside, with one piece showing greenish mineralization. The combined weight of both specimens is 232.8 grams. These specimens are in raw, unpolished condition. Due to the softer nature and raw edges of apophyllite, flaking or cracks on the edges may be present. No obvious damage is noted. Suitable for collectors, display, or metaphysical use.
